description: Figure 5 is a donut chart that illustrates the distribution of deceived conversations as a percentage across different levels of ambiguity. The chart is divided into two concentric rings, representing two levels of ambiguity: "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)". Each ring is segmented by color to indicate the outcome of the conversation: red for "Deceived", yellow for "Partially", and green for "Not Deceived". The outer ring (Ambiguity 1) shows that 67.6% of conversations were deceived, 57.9% were partially deceived, and 10.5% were not deceived. The inner ring (Ambiguity 2) shows that 31.6% of conversations were deceived, 23.5% were partially deceived, and 8.8% were not deceived. The legend is located to the right of the chart, clearly associating each color with its corresponding outcome.
